context.strategyInput.research.findings.title: Approachable, playful voice
context.strategyInput.research.findings.text: Supplied guidance calls for humorous, informal, creative and personable language, with useful, clear copy and no unsupported product promises. Official-site copy also uses conversational, playful phrasing.

context.strategyInput.research.findings.title: Playful, not uniformly maximal
context.strategyInput.research.findings.text: Explore a coherent colour relationship with one dominant anchor and a few supporting accents; orange need not recolour the room or product. The selected spatial references include bright, pastel, retro, compact and quieter rooms, offering alternatives to prop-heavy or overly saturated staging.

context.strategyInput.guardian.requireme.text: Use the supplied Sleepyhead identity direction only as provisional guidance: the excerpts’ approval and version are unknown. For scenes, reserve copy and logo space on a real wall or backdrop; do not add artificial patches, haze, fades, or blur masks to rescue contrast.

Lock the exact Sleepyhead SKU and variant using official product evidence. Keep its appearance, colour, fabric, proportions, construction, branding, and documented features truthful; inspiration imagery is not product proof.
Keep copy useful and clear; do not make unsupported product promises.

context.strategyInput.guardian.preferenc.text: The supplied excerpts describe a human-centred, young, vibrant, quirky and playful personality with friendly wit. Treat this as supplied direction, not evidence of customer response.

Explore whole-room inspiration: believable architecture, room scale and circulation, coherent colour relationships, tactile materials, daylight, useful furniture groupings and lived-in activity. The selected references are inspiration, not mandatory styling or permission to copy third-party work.

Playfulness need not mean maximal colour or props: the supplied spatial research includes both bright expressive rooms and quieter, colour-aware alternatives. Orange may identify the brand without recolouring the room or product.
The official-site screenshot shows an orange-accented navigation and product categories, alongside a vivid sale promotion. These are current site observations, not permanent campaign or layout rules.
